The whole National Socialist agitation is a constant appeal to the inner swine in man.
innerer Schweinehund.et: Originally student slang, from older Sauhund.

On German Lufthansa, flights within Germany to and from Frankfurt and Munich are sometimes more than 50% occupied by transferring passengers.
between East Germany and West Germany
Die vielen innerdeutschen Straßen, Wege und Eisenbahnlinien, die diese Grenze schneidet, sind unterbrochen.
The many roads, paths and railways between East and West Germany, which this border cuts through, are interrupted.
Im Paketverkehr machten die innerdeutschen Sendungen über 10% des jeweiligen Gesamtvolumens der beiden Postverwaltungen aus und lagen damit weit über den Auslandspaketen.
For parcel delivery, shipments between East and West Germany made up over 10% of the total volume of both post offices at that time, and were therefore far more common than international parcels.

s: innovative power, innovative strength, capacity for innovation (the ability of an entity to generate and realize new, value-creating solutions)
Die mittelständischen Unternehmen sind der Motor der deutschen Innovationskraft.
Medium-sized companies are the engine of German innovative strength.
compulsion to innovate, innovation pressure (the necessity for companies or economies to continuously develop new products or processes to remain competitive)
In der hochautomatisierten Industriegesellschaft führt der technologische Fortschritt zu einem permanenten Innovationszwang, um die globale Wirtschaftskraft zu sichern.
In the highly automated industrial society, technological progress leads to a permanent compulsion to innovate in order to secure global economic power.
Besonders im Wissenssektor ist der Innovationszwang so hoch, dass ein kurzzeitiger Stillstand sofort den Jahresüberschuss und die künftige Zahlungskraft gefährdet.
Especially in the knowledge sector, the compulsion to innovate is so high that a brief standstill immediately endangers the annual surplus and future solvency.
built-up area (land located within an established settled area of a municipality)
inner ring road, inner beltway (a ring road surrounding a city center)
Wegen einer Baustelle staut sich der Verkehr auf dem Innenstadtring.
Due to a construction site, traffic is backing up on the inner ring road.
Die Stadtverwaltung möchte den Innenstadtring für den Radverkehr sicherer gestalten.
The city administration wants to make the inner city ring road safer for bicycle traffic.
Die Autos quälen sich morgens im Schneckentempo über den Innenring.
In the morning, cars crawl at a snail's pace along the inner ring road.
inner ring (in geometry, mechanics, or targets)
Der Pfeil traf genau das Zentrum innerhalb des Innenrings.
The arrow hit right in the center inside the inner ring.
